I don’t have real‑time exchange‑rate data built into this chat, but as a quick reference:

- Roughly 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP (this figure varies day‑to‑day).
- Using that approximation, 20 USD × 0.78 ≈ **£15.60**.

Keep in mind that actual rates fluctuate constantly, so you’ll get a slightly different amount if you check a live currency converter or your bank’s quote at the time of the transaction.
